Which of these pictures corresponds best to the idea that the quantity Q is $5 \pm 2$?

```{r}
#| label: fig-D-07-ehso
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Three relative probability distributions"
#| fig-subcap: 
#| - " "
#| - " "
#| - " "
#| - " "

#| echo: false
label <- function(P) {
  P |> 
    gf_labs(x="Q", y = "Relative prob.") |>
    gf_theme(theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 24),
                   axis.title=element_text(size=24,face="bold")))
}
dom <- domain(x = 0:10)
slice_plot(dnorm(x, mean=4.5, sd=1) ~ x, dom, npts=500) |> label()
slice_plot(dbeta((x+3)/15, 20, 13) ~ x, dom, npts=500) |> label()
slice_plot((dnorm(x, mean=3, sd=0.5) + dnorm(x, mean=7, sd=0.65))/2 ~ x, dom, npts=500) |> label()
slice_plot(dnorm(x, mean=5.5, sd=3) ~ x, dom, npts=500) |> label()
```
```{mcq}
#| label: D-07-ehso
#| inline: true
1. a [correct]
2. b [hint: Five is not the most likely value.]
3. c [hint: Five is not the most likely value.]
4. d [hint: Much too broad.]
```
:::
